description: The Assembly '94 Pre-Invitation Intro by Future Crew and Sonic PC, the organizers' first invitation to Assembly '94 in Helsinki, running from its original files in your browser.
about: The Assembly '94 Pre-Invitation Intro is the organizers' first invitation to Assembly '94, held from 5 to 7 August 1994 in Helsinki, released on 8 April 1994. Future Crew made it with Sonic PC, who did the code.
Its text file gives the party's preliminary information and promises another invitation intro, which followed in July: the Assembly '94 Invitation Dentro.
It plays in a loop, about three and a half minutes a pass, until Escape, which shows a contact screen and returns to DOS.
released: Released on 8 April 1994, as the organizers' first invitation to Assembly '94 (5 to 7 August 1994, Helsinki).
credits: Code by Mik of Sonic PC. Design and graphics by Marvel, the Assembly '94 logo by Pixel, music by Purple Motion and texts by GORE, of Future Crew.
terms: Freeware: “This demo is freeware. It can be freely distributed without modifications. No money can be charged for it.” (README.1ST)
accuracy: DosKit gives it a Gravis UltraSound and no Sound Blaster, and picks GUS autodetection in its sound card menu.
Mono: js-dos mixes the two channels into one.
Not yet compared with a capture made on real hardware.
imageAlt: A screen of the Assembly '94 Pre-Invitation Intro, running in DosKit
